title: WHO: Physical activity
summary: The WHO overview describes the health benefits of physical activity and recommends adults get at least 150 minutes of moderate-intensity activity each week.

title: CDC: Health benefits of physical activity for adults
summary: The CDC summarizes how regular physical activity can improve sleep, reduce anxiety, and support heart and brain health.

title: NHS: Physical activity guidelines for adults
summary: The NHS outlines weekly activity guidance for adults aged 19 to 64, including aerobic activity and strength exercises.
